turns.patient_answer: I would say no—I haven’t noticed any uncontrollable twitching, jerking, or involuntary movements that I can’t stop, though I do have a mild hand tremor.

turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lump or swelling in my right breast.”

turns.patient_answer: “No, pressing or tapping around my belly button doesn’t feel tender or painful.”
